rank_up.Friendly: The council recognizes your escort record. I name you a Republic Auxiliary; keep the lanes open, and our patrols will answer your call.
rank_up.Trusted: You held the line when it mattered. I trust you with Vanguard duty and the Republic's heaviest contracts.
rank_up.Honored: The fleet council records you as the Shield of the Republic. When our people call, my command channel is yours.

rank_down.Unfriendly: Your recent choices have cost the Republic confidence. Until you make amends, our crews will treat you as an uncertain contact.
rank_down.Hostile: I will not let another Republic convoy suffer for your actions. Our patrols are cleared to stop you on sight.

contracts.title: Supply Line
contracts.briefing: Escort a ration hauler through a contested Republic lane. Keep it intact until it reaches the settlement dock.
contracts.success: The convoy arrived with its cargo and crew safe. The council has logged your service.

contracts.title: Civilian Shield
contracts.briefing: Reaver raiders are closing on an evacuation shuttle. Drive off the attackers before the passengers are exposed.
contracts.success: The civilians are clear. Your restraint under fire will be remembered.

contracts.title: Hold the Relay
contracts.briefing: A Republic relay is under pressure. Hold the marked zone until the replacement patrol arrives.
contracts.success: Relay control is secure. Our formation can move again.

contracts.title: Range Scan
contracts.briefing: Scan civilian traffic near the lane junction and report any distress or route hazards.
contracts.success: Traffic is logged and the safe passage report is filed.

contracts.title: Raider Bounty
contracts.briefing: A Reaver cutter has been preying on Republic supply craft. Claim the posted bounty by bringing it down.
contracts.success: The cutter will trouble no more convoys. Bounty confirmed.

contracts.title: Shield Plate Return
contracts.briefing: Collect surplus shield plates from the depot circuit and sell the recovered stock to the Republic quartermaster.
contracts.success: The plates are back in service. Settlement crews send thanks.

contracts.title: Evacuation Guard
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your last attack forced families from a Republic settlement. Escort their evacuation shuttle to safety.
contracts.success: The families reached shelter. The council accepts this act of repair.

contracts.title: Search the Wreck
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your fire crippled a Republic relief skiff. Rescue its stranded crew before life support fails.
contracts.success: The skiff's crew is alive and accounted for. You have begun to repay the harm.

secret_weapon.name: Aegis Longwatch
secret_weapon.lore: A Republic railgun tuned for patient command crews: its clean white coil flash marks a shot designed to end a threat before it reaches a convoy.

secret_ship.name: SRS Resolute
secret_ship.signature_feature: Layered shield-emitter lattice around a central command spine
secret_ship.lore: The Resolute takes the first strike in a mixed patrol and holds position until every Republic vessel can withdraw.

rank_up.Friendly: You kept your word when the hull started burning. My crew will share a table with you now; don't make me regret it.
rank_up.Trusted: The crew voted you a full share. Take the good contracts, and remember who hauled you out of the fire.
rank_up.Honored: You're captain among captains on this deck. Nobody touches your cut while I still draw breath.

rank_down.Unfriendly: Word is you left our people short. You can still square the account, but my crew won't spot you another favor.
rank_down.Hostile: You crossed the line and took from the crew. We have your trail; every Reaver you meet knows the price.

contracts.title: Easy Pickings
contracts.briefing: A soft target is carrying a posted bounty through Reaver space. Intercept it before another captain claims the purse.
contracts.success: Purse secured. Your share is waiting at the firebox.

contracts.title: Fence the Salvage
contracts.briefing: Gather loose salvage from the marked wreck field and sell the useful haul through the crew's fence.
contracts.success: The salvage sold cleanly. The crew has its cut.

contracts.title: Crew in the Drift
contracts.briefing: A Reaver skiff was abandoned after a bad jump. Find its crew and bring them back before scavengers arrive.
contracts.success: They're back aboard, loud and alive. That's a fair day's work.

contracts.title: Break the Tail
contracts.briefing: A captured hauler has patrols on its wake. Escort it through the marked escape lane.
contracts.success: The hauler slipped the patrol net. Cargo and crew are ours.

contracts.title: Burn the Tollhouse
contracts.briefing: A debt marshal station is locking down a Reaver passage. Destroy the station and clear the lane.
contracts.success: No more tolls from that station. The route is open.

contracts.title: Find the Ledger
contracts.briefing: Locate a stolen crew ledger in the wreck field. Whoever has it knows which captains still owe a share.
contracts.success: Ledger found. Names and shares are back where they belong.

contracts.title: Miner's Safe Passage
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your last raid left civilian miners under fire. Defend them until their shuttle clears the field.
contracts.success: The miners made it out. That's one debt we can stop carrying.

contracts.title: Return the Med Crate
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your crew took medicine from a stranded hauler. Find the marked crate and return it to its owners.
contracts.success: The medicine is back with the hauler's crew. Mara says the account is smaller now.

secret_weapon.name: Redhand Rotary
secret_weapon.lore: A captured rotary gun rebuilt with scavenged feed drums. It spits a brutal amber storm, and Mara insists every round is already paid for.

secret_ship.name: Pillager's Due
secret_ship.signature_feature: A welded ram prow wrapped around a salvaged furnace core
secret_ship.lore: Crews earn the Due by surviving a season aboard it; its mismatched armor is a record of every ship that failed to take it.

rank_up.Friendly: Your signal has become familiar among the young. I mark you Nesting Ally; carry this trust gently.
rank_up.Trusted: The Brood remembers your care. You are Brood-Kin now, and our nest calls will reach you first.
rank_up.Honored: We share our oldest memory with you. Guard it as you guard the living, Memory-Guardian.

rank_down.Unfriendly: Your signal brings unease to the nest. Restore what you disturbed, and the young may hear you again.
rank_down.Hostile: The Brood has marked your signal as danger. Leave our nesting grounds, or we will answer together.

contracts.title: Nest Signal
contracts.briefing: Find the missing brood signal among the quiet rocks. The nest cannot answer until its memory beacon is returned.
contracts.success: The signal is heard again. The nest remembers your path.

contracts.title: Escort the Brood
contracts.briefing: Guide a brood carrier through the outer passage while its young settle into their travel shells.
contracts.success: The carrier reached quiet space. The young are safe.

contracts.title: Nest Perimeter
contracts.briefing: Hold the marked nesting zone while memory keepers complete their signal exchange.
contracts.success: The signal exchange is complete. The nest is calm.

contracts.title: Retrieve the Young
contracts.briefing: Rescue broodlings stranded in a damaged travel pod before its shell breaks apart.
contracts.success: The broodlings are returned to the nest. Their signal is bright.

contracts.title: Predator Cull
contracts.briefing: Remove the hostile predator craft circling the brood route. The young cannot travel while it hunts.
contracts.success: The predator threat is gone. The route is quiet.

contracts.title: Silence the Drill
contracts.briefing: Destroy the unmanned drilling station disturbing a nearby nesting ground.
contracts.success: The drilling signal has stopped. The nest can rest.

contracts.title: Return the Young
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your attack scattered a brood travel pod. Rescue the young before the cold reaches them.
contracts.success: The young are safe. The Brood holds your new signal beside the old harm.

contracts.title: Quiet the Nest
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your weapons disturbed a nest transit. Defend the marked zone while brood carriers regroup.
contracts.success: The carriers regrouped without loss. The nest has heard your repair.

secret_weapon.name: Mnemic Spore
secret_weapon.lore: A living focusing array remembers its target through every pulse. The Brood lends it only to a pilot who has protected the young.

secret_ship.name: Cradle of Echoes
secret_ship.signature_feature: Twin nest pods linked by a living signal spine
secret_ship.lore: The Cradle carries memory keepers between nests, its paired pods pulsing with the shared history of every broodling aboard.

rank_up.Friendly: Your account now carries a positive risk rating. I welcome you as a Bonded Partner; the service terms are attached.
rank_up.Trusted: Your reliability has earned Preferred Principal status. I have approved access to a private armament line.
rank_up.Honored: The board has entered your name among our Chartered Benefactors. You may consider the Syndicate's routes available to you.

rank_down.Unfriendly: Your recent decisions have increased our exposure. I can still offer an amends contract, but no further credit is authorized.
rank_down.Hostile: Your account is closed and your access revoked. Any outstanding risk will be settled by our enforcement office.

contracts.title: Vault Transfer
contracts.briefing: Escort a sealed Varn vault transport between two insured docks. Keep the cargo intact for the full route.
contracts.success: Delivery recorded without loss. Your fee has cleared.

contracts.title: Recover the Account
contracts.briefing: Find a lost contract ledger in the marked debris field. The Syndicate requires the original record.
contracts.success: Ledger recovered. The account is reconciled.

contracts.title: Cargo Margin
contracts.briefing: Gather saleable freight from the listed caches and sell it through the approved Varn exchange.
contracts.success: The exchange confirms the sale. Your margin is settled.

contracts.title: Contract Enforcer
contracts.briefing: A known contract breaker has a bounty on their ship. Collect the fee and close the file.
contracts.success: The file is closed. The agreed payment is yours.

contracts.title: Route Audit
contracts.briefing: Scan civilian traffic near the insured corridor and report route disruptions to the claims office.
contracts.success: The audit is filed. Insured traffic can proceed.

contracts.title: Secure the Dock
contracts.briefing: Hold the marked transfer zone until the dock's cargo cranes finish their scheduled cycle.
contracts.success: Transfer zone secured. No claims were opened.

contracts.title: Repaid Losses
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your seizure voided a Varn cargo policy. Recover the marked goods and sell them through the claim desk.
contracts.success: The claim desk accepted the recovered value. Your liability has decreased.

contracts.title: Claim Escort
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your attack stranded a Varn assessor. Escort the claims shuttle as it pays affected carriers.
contracts.success: The shuttle completed its route. The claimants have been paid.

secret_weapon.name: Quiet Clause
secret_weapon.lore: A precision railgun hidden inside a polished Varn mount. Its pale charge gives no warning until a contract breaker is already out of options.

secret_ship.name: Indemnity Crown
secret_ship.signature_feature: A sealed cargo bastion surrounding a concealed command core
secret_ship.lore: The ship appears on the ledger as a secure transfer vessel; its protected core ensures the Syndicate's most important cargo arrives intact.

rank_up.Friendly: You've put in honest work for the settlements. I call you a Trusted Hand; the next crew will know your name.
rank_up.Trusted: The councils trust you with the belt's hardest shifts. Take the Defender's contract and bring everybody home.
rank_up.Honored: The councils have made you their Shield. That means our people call, and I expect you to answer.

rank_down.Unfriendly: You left a settlement carrying the cost of your choices. Work it off, and we can talk like neighbors again.
rank_down.Hostile: You put our families at risk. I won't send another crew to warn you; stay clear of Militia ground.

contracts.title: Rig Guard
contracts.briefing: Hold the marked mining rig zone while the shift crew completes a repair cycle.
contracts.success: The rig is working and the crew is back on shift.

contracts.title: Evac Escort
contracts.briefing: Escort a settlement evacuation shuttle past the belt's unstable debris.
contracts.success: The shuttle reached shelter with its passengers safe.

contracts.title: Shift Bounty
contracts.briefing: A Reaver raider has been hitting work crews between shifts. Claim the Militia bounty.
contracts.success: The raider is gone. Workers can cross the belt again.

contracts.title: Scrap Returns
contracts.briefing: Gather usable hull scrap from the listed wrecks and sell it to the settlement workshop.
contracts.success: The workshop bought the scrap. Those parts will keep a rig running.

contracts.title: Missing Tool Crate
contracts.briefing: Find the missing workshop tool crate before the next repair shift starts.
contracts.success: The tools are back in the hands of the crews.

contracts.title: Protect the Miners
contracts.briefing: Hostile ships are approaching a civilian mining crew. Drive them away before anyone is hurt.
contracts.success: The miners finished their shift and returned home.

contracts.title: Hold the Shelter
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your attack damaged a settlement power shelter. Defend the marked zone while workers restore it.
contracts.success: The shelter is holding again. The settlement has room to trust you.

contracts.title: Mine Rescue
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: workers were trapped after your strike damaged their rig. Rescue the crew before the air runs out.
contracts.success: The workers are out. Dax says that counts for something.

secret_weapon.name: Last Shift
secret_weapon.lore: An ironclad siege cannon rebuilt from mining hardware. Its heavy orange shot is reserved for threats that put a settlement at risk.

secret_ship.name: Foundry Sentinel
secret_ship.signature_feature: Replaceable armor bulwarks built around a central repair spine
secret_ship.lore: The Sentinel is assembled from workshop-standard plates, so a settlement can mend it even when the nearest shipyard is weeks away.

rank_up.Friendly: That's a clean run and a safer route for everyone. The Combine welcomes you as a Clear-Lane Partner.
rank_up.Trusted: Your record is consistent under pressure. I have Principal access approved, including a weapon line normally kept in reserve.
rank_up.Honored: You've kept our routes open when the margins got thin. The board names you Route Patron, and I couldn't be happier.

rank_down.Unfriendly: Your last decisions delayed too many people. Help us repair the route record, and we can reopen your carrier status.
rank_down.Hostile: You have become a hazard to Combine traffic. Our escorts will turn you away until the board reviews your account.

contracts.title: Courier Window
contracts.briefing: Escort a Helion courier through the scheduled transit window. Keep the route clear until delivery.
contracts.success: On-time delivery. I knew that flight plan had a good pilot.

contracts.title: Trade Boost
contracts.briefing: Gather listed power cells from the route caches and sell them through a Helion station exchange.
contracts.success: The exchange cleared the cargo. Nice work keeping the supply chain moving.

contracts.title: Lane Survey
contracts.briefing: Scan civilian ships crossing the trade junction and file their route status with dispatch.
contracts.success: Traffic is mapped and the lane report is in. Thanks for the clean survey.

contracts.title: Clear the Route
contracts.briefing: Remove the hostile raider type disrupting the courier lanes. Dispatch has marked the search area.
contracts.success: The route is clear. Couriers can keep their promised windows.

contracts.title: Beacon Recovery
contracts.briefing: Find a lost navigation beacon near the outer route split and return its signal to dispatch.
contracts.success: Beacon found and logged. The route map is useful again.

contracts.title: Passenger Safety
contracts.briefing: Hostile craft are threatening a civilian passenger line. Defend the ships until they leave the danger zone.
contracts.success: All passengers are clear. That's a good day's flying.

contracts.title: Passenger Recovery
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your attack scattered a Helion passenger shuttle. Rescue the survivors from the marked area.
contracts.success: The passengers are safe. I have marked the route record as repaired.

contracts.title: Restitution Run
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your strike delayed a food convoy. Escort the replacement cargo to the settlement dock.
contracts.success: The food arrived before stores ran low. That matters more than the paperwork.

secret_weapon.name: Sunlane Arc
secret_weapon.lore: A fast-cycling arc projector built for route defense. Its blue-white discharge disables a threat before it can close on a courier.

secret_ship.name: Far Meridian
secret_ship.signature_feature: Paired solar collector fins feeding a bright central drive spine
secret_ship.lore: The Far Meridian keeps a convoy moving across distant systems, with collectors shaped to work far from a friendly station.

rank_up.Friendly: You've answered the call without claiming the route. I welcome you as a Warden Auxiliary; keep that beacon lit.
rank_up.Trusted: You bring people home and leave passage open. I name you Ranger Associate, with my full trust on the frontier.
rank_up.Honored: The Authority names you Frontier Beacon. When a ship is lost beyond the chart, your word will guide us there.

rank_down.Unfriendly: Your conduct has made the route less safe. Help the crews you put at risk, and I'll reconsider your clearance.
rank_down.Hostile: You have violated the Authority's open-route charter. Our patrols will stop you before you endanger another traveler.

contracts.title: Beacon Cache
contracts.briefing: Find the route beacon lost beyond the marked passage. Its signal is needed by every ship following you.
contracts.success: The beacon is back online. Passage is clear again.

contracts.title: Open-Lane Scan
contracts.briefing: Scan civilian traffic along the frontier corridor and report any ship requesting assistance.
contracts.success: Every signal is accounted for. The route remains open.

contracts.title: Relief Convoy
contracts.briefing: Escort a relief hauler to an isolated settlement. Keep the ship on course until it docks.
contracts.success: The relief cargo reached the settlement. Good flying.

contracts.title: Civilian Screen
contracts.briefing: A hostile ship is closing on civilian travelers. Defend them until they can leave the area.
contracts.success: The travelers are safe and the lane is open.

contracts.title: Drifter Bounty
contracts.briefing: A raider is stalking distress beacons on the frontier. Claim the Authority's posted bounty.
contracts.success: The raider is gone. Fewer ships will have to call for help.

contracts.title: Rescue Kit Trade
contracts.briefing: Gather rescue kits from the listed caches and sell them to the Authority's remote outpost.
contracts.success: The outpost has stocked its rescue lockers. Thanks for the practical help.

contracts.title: Beacon Repair
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your attack damaged a public route relay. Defend its zone while Authority crews restore the beacon.
contracts.success: The route beacon is back. Your amends have helped keep passage public.

contracts.title: Stranded Passengers
contracts.briefing: Amends contract: your fire left travelers stranded beyond the route marker. Rescue them and bring them to safety.
contracts.success: The passengers are safe. I'll record that you chose to repair the harm.

secret_weapon.name: Open Passage
secret_weapon.lore: An Authority railgun with a blue-white charge and a narrow shot. Rangers reserve it for threats that block a public route.

secret_ship.name: Wayfarer Prime
secret_ship.signature_feature: A reinforced ram nose surrounding a long-range beacon array
secret_ship.lore: The Wayfarer Prime works beyond reliable comms, leaving a clear route marker wherever it finds a stranded crew.
